name: Moonbeam
material: Moonseed and a piece of opalescent feldspar
description: A column of pale light, 5 feet in radius and 40 feet tall. Creatures entering or starting their turn there make a Constitution save or take 2d10 radiant damage, half on a success. You can move it as an action.
at_higher_levels: Damage rises by 1d10 per slot level above 2.
